facts: I speak English and Urdu fluently, and Hindi and Punjabi conversationally.

approach: When something does not work, I change one thing at a time and test again. On my ENES100 team that meant reprinting a wheel mount five times until it fit, then tracking a drifting vehicle down to a blocked motor and then to uneven motor speeds.
intro: I am a second year mechanical engineering track student at the University of Maryland, planning a minor in business analytics. I like taking things apart, figuring out why they work, and building them better.
story:
I got into engineering by taking toys apart and putting them back together to see if they still worked. My dad was a mechanical engineer, and that is one of the reasons I chose it too.

I grew up in Abu Dhabi and Pakistan and moved to the United States in 2018. From 2022 to 2026 I worked as an assistant mechanic at an auto repair shop, doing oil changes, brake and rotor jobs and tire rotations on about 20 vehicles a week.
